mechanisms.name: EngineArgs to VllmConfig resolution
mechanisms.trigger: every engine start: LLM(), vllm serve, bench, once per create_engine_config call
mechanisms.observable: logging is configured, the platform runs its pre-register hook and env check, then ModelConfig, CacheConfig, ParallelConfig, SpeculativeConfig, SchedulerConfig and the rest are built in order and VllmConfig cross-validates them, or startup fails with a ValueError
mechanisms.note: Order and main builders are modeled, but LoRA, load, kernel, mamba and compilation overrides are not built, the logging and env-check stages are missing, and several readers (engine core, kernels-ops) read static world config instead of the resolved result.

mechanisms.name: Platform detection and plugin activation
mechanisms.trigger: first read of vllm.platforms.current_platform in a process
mechanisms.observable: VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu wins outright; otherwise tpu, cuda, rocm, xpu, cpu and vllm.platform_plugins are probed; one out-of-tree plugin beats built-ins, two active at one tier raises RuntimeError, none gives UnspecifiedPlatform

mechanisms.name: current_platform lazy singleton
mechanisms.trigger: module attribute access or assignment on vllm.platforms
mechanisms.observable: the platform class is instantiated once, after plugins can register, and cached with its init trace; assignment replaces it; unknown names raise AttributeError

mechanisms.name: Async scheduling resolution
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: an explicit True hard-fails on incompatible speculative methods, unpadded drafts, unsupported executors or ROCm DeepEP high-throughput DBO; None becomes True unless pooling or one of those conditions turns it off with a warning
mechanisms.note: The ROCm DeepEP high-throughput DBO hard failure and auto-disable branches (lines 1557-1562, 1627-1633) are not in the behavior; the other branches match.

mechanisms.name: Optimization level defaults (-O0 to -O3)
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__, after platform defaults and IR op priorities
mechanisms.observable: each level fills only still-unset compile, pass, cudagraph and kernel fields, callables evaluated against the config, so user values survive and fusions and cudagraph mode change by level
mechanisms.note: Only fuse_act_quant, fuse_allreduce_rms and cudagraph_mode per level are modeled; the other fusions and enable_flashinfer_autotune are missing.

mechanisms.name: Compilation mode and custom-op defaults
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: enforce_eager and TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE force mode NONE; unset mode is VLLM_COMPILE above -O0; torch wrap and the all or none custom-op default follow mode and backend; blocked weights add +quant_fp8
mechanisms.note: enforce_eager and the unset-mode default are modeled; TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE, JIT warmup disable, torch wrap and custom-op defaults are not.

mechanisms.name: Model Runner V1 or V2 selection
mechanisms.trigger: use_v2_model_runner property read during config and at worker init
mechanisms.observable: HiSparse and watermarking force V2; VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER wins next; no Triton or any unsupported feature falls back to V1 with a warning naming the features
mechanisms.note: Behaviors read a use_v2_model_runner value as input; nothing computes it or rejects unsupported V1 and V2 features.

mechanisms.name: Hybrid KV cache manager enablement
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: explicit disable is respected; no preference auto-disables on platforms without support, chunked local attention, or connectors lacking HMA; explicit enable in those cases raises ValueError

mechanisms.name: KV offloading flags to KV connector
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__ when kv_offloading_size is set
mechanisms.observable: native selects SimpleCPUOffloadConnector or OffloadingConnector with cpu_bytes_to_use, lmcache selects LMCacheMPConnector, and kv_role becomes kv_both

mechanisms.name: Per-architecture config hooks
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__, once per ModelConfig
mechanisms.observable: MODELS_CONFIG_MAP, hybrid and classify hooks rewrite the config for the architecture, and a Run:ai object-store model forces a compatible load_format or raises

mechanisms.name: Platform check_and_update_config hook
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__, after the cross-config checks
mechanisms.observable: the active platform has the last word: it sets worker_cls, forces disable_chunked_mm_input for bidirectional-MM models, and rewrites or rejects settings per device
mechanisms.note: Dispatch only reaches CUDA and CPU; ROCm and XPU hooks are not modeled, and the CUDA WSL warning is missing.

mechanisms.name: CPU platform config rewrite
mechanisms.trigger: CpuPlatform.check_and_update_config on the CPU platform
mechanisms.observable: block size is forced by MLA kernel and DeepSeek-V4, the mamba SSM dtype policy is applied, DBO and async scheduling are turned off, compile mode and LoRA are adjusted, and executor env vars are exported
mechanisms.note: Only block size and the GDN SSM dtype policy are modeled; lines 323-411 (KV space, scheduling, DBO, compile, env setup) are not.

mechanisms.name: XPU platform config rewrite
mechanisms.trigger: XPUPlatform.check_and_update_config on the XPU platform
mechanisms.observable: compile sizes and unsupported fusions are disabled, the launcher falls back under UVA offload, spawn is forced, UCX cache is disabled, and shutdown_timeout rises to 5

mechanisms.name: ROCm platform defaults and hooks
mechanisms.trigger: ROCm pre-register and config defaults during VllmConfig setup
mechanisms.observable: GPU_PINNED_MIN_XFER_SIZE is set, AITER flags add or override custom ops such as +quant_fp8 and +grouped_topk, PCP downgrades FULL cudagraphs to PIECEWISE, and unsupported models are rejected

mechanisms.name: Snapshot create transaction
mechanisms.trigger: vllm snapshot create
mechanisms.observable: a sleep-mode child boots, reports ready with an oracle, is inventoried and dumped with CRIU, verified dead, and its manifest published atomically; any failure kills the group and deletes the artifact

mechanisms.name: Snapshot restore transaction
mechanisms.trigger: vllm snapshot restore
mechanisms.observable: after identity checks CRIU restores the tree, the release marker hands it host and port, the HTTP listener comes up, and an HTTP oracle must match the manifest before the restore completes

mechanisms.name: Snapshot child canary, rehearsal and release barrier
mechanisms.trigger: python -m vllm.snapshot.server, launched by snapshot create
mechanisms.observable: the child runs a canary, rehearses sleep and wake and compares outputs, detaches streams, writes ready.json, polls release.json every 50 ms, wakes and serves on the released address
mechanisms.note: Canary calls are real, but comparison and marker arrival are scenario choices, sleep and wake and marker files never happen, and serving is a constant return.

mechanisms.name: Worker profiler session state machine
mechanisms.trigger: /start_profile or LLM.start_profile through collective_rpc, then each worker step
mechanisms.observable: one active session at a time with per-session delay and max iterations; a delayed start triggers on the delay-th step, schedule warmup steps do not count toward the max, and reaching max stops it through stop() so a later start works
mechanisms.note: Session states match the code except warmup: worker-profiler.step counts every running step although its title says non-warmup, so max_iterations fires early under a warmup schedule (wrapper.py:148-149, 426-434).

mechanisms.name: Logical, visible and physical device ID mapping
mechanisms.trigger: worker device init, topology and management calls; --device-ids at config time
mechanisms.observable: assigned IDs or the device control env map logical ranks to physical devices and torch ordinals; duplicates, out-of-range and invisible IDs raise, and an empty env counts as unset

mechanisms.name: Entry-point plugin group loader
mechanisms.trigger: any plugin group load, such as general, platform, IO or endpoint
mechanisms.observable: entry points are discovered, filtered by VLLM_PLUGINS (unset allows all), and loaded; a failed load is logged and skipped

mechanisms.name: General plugin load once per process
mechanisms.trigger: EngineArgs init, ModelRegistry subprocess, engine core and worker init
mechanisms.observable: vllm.general_plugins functions run once per process, registering models or LoRA resolvers, and a plugin exception reaches the caller
mechanisms.note: The loader and the once guard match; the engine core and registry subprocess callers are not wired.

mechanisms.name: Endpoint plugin gate and route attach
mechanisms.trigger: API server app build, then app state init
mechanisms.observable: endpoint plugins load only when named in VLLM_PLUGINS and matching a served task; their routes replace core routes by path and method, OpenAPI resets, then each plugin initializes per-app state
mechanisms.note: The load gate matches but no caller reaches it from app build, and route override and init_state are absent.

mechanisms.name: Logging configuration
mechanisms.trigger: import of vllm.logger and again from LoggingConfig in create_engine_config
mechanisms.observable: the root vLLM logger gets its handler, level, stream and color or newline formatters, or a user config file; configuring off with a file raises, and platform warnings log after setup

mechanisms.name: Environment variable registry and cache
mechanisms.trigger: any vllm.envs attribute read; cache enabled after engine core and worker init
mechanisms.observable: variables are parsed from os.environ on each read with choice validation until enable_envs_cache evaluates all of them once, after which changes are ignored; unknown names raise AttributeError
mechanisms.note: Each behavior matches the code, but they run only from their own flows: engine core and worker never enable the cache, and no other interface reads through envs.getattr.

mechanisms.name: Unknown VLLM_ variable check
mechanisms.trigger: Platform.validate_environ during create_engine_config
mechanisms.observable: any VLLM_ variable not in the registry logs a warning, or raises ValueError when fail_on_environ_validation is set

mechanisms.name: CUDA attention backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: selector.get_attn_backend for each attention layer on CUDA
mechanisms.observable: a selected backend is validated alone; otherwise the first valid backend in the device capability priority order wins, and none valid raises a ValueError listing every reason
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines against the code, not expression by expression.

mechanisms.name: ROCm, CPU and XPU attention backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: selector.get_attn_backend on non-CUDA platforms
mechanisms.observable: ROCm walks AITER, ROCM_ATTN and Triton priorities; CPU picks AMX_MLA, CPU_MLA or CPU_ATTN and refuses sparse attention; XPU chooses its own backend

mechanisms.name: MLA prefill backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: get_mla_prefill_backend at model init for MLA models
mechanisms.observable: an explicit backend is validated; otherwise the device capability priority list gives the first importable valid backend, and none valid is a ValueError
mechanisms.note: ROCm has its own selector at rocm.py:912 that is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: ViT attention backend selection
mechanisms.trigger: vision encoder construction for multimodal models
mechanisms.observable: a supported --mm-encoder-attn-backend override is used, invalid is refused, otherwise FlashAttention when the head size fits, else a platform fallback
mechanisms.note: Only the CUDA path is modeled.

mechanisms.name: KV block size selection and alignment
mechanisms.trigger: Platform.update_block_size_for_backend once attention backends are known
mechanisms.observable: a block size every backend accepts is chosen by LCM search or ValueError, hybrid models align mamba and attention page sizes, and multi-dtype KV layouts realign, overriding --block-size when required
mechanisms.note: The backend predicates exist, but the three-phase selection, hybrid and heterogeneous alignment, and validate_block_size are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Hardware batch limit defaults
mechanisms.trigger: EngineArgs resolution when max_num_batched_tokens or max_num_seqs is unset
mechanisms.observable: defaults come from usage context, device memory and name, TPU chip or CPU world size, doubled by performance_mode=throughput, then clamped against max_model_len and max_num_seqs
mechanisms.note: The defaults table, throughput doubling and clamps match the code; the multimodal prefix-LM floor at lines 3147-3162 is missing.

mechanisms.name: Chunked prefill and prefix caching defaults
mechanisms.trigger: EngineArgs resolution before CacheConfig
mechanisms.observable: unset flags take what the model supports, with a warning for unsupported disable, and RISC-V CPUs turn both off
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines, not expression by expression.

mechanisms.name: Runner and convert resolution
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: --runner and --convert win; auto uses sentence-transformers markers, registry flags, then architecture suffix; incompatible combinations raise ValueError

mechanisms.name: HF config load and override
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: the checkpoint config is fetched, hf_overrides applied, the text config and rope parameters normalized, and the architecture config derived; an unknown repo raises ValueError
mechanisms.note: Callable overrides apply by name only and revision handling is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Model redirect, revision pin and tokenizer defaults
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: served names are fixed first, model and tokenizer pass through maybe_model_redirect, each repo revision is resolved once, sleep mode availability is checked, and the tokenizer mode defaults by architecture

mechanisms.name: Transformers backend and class overrides
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig registry access in the front end and every worker
mechanisms.observable: model_class_overrides register once per process with a warning, and unregistered architectures can fall back to a Transformers backend class

mechanisms.name: Model dtype resolution
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: auto takes the checkpoint dtype, falling back to the first platform-supported dtype; explicit values are verified or refused against the platform
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines.

mechanisms.name: max_model_len derivation
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: the context length is derived from the HF config and a user override is checked; a non-positive result is refused
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines.

mechanisms.name: Quantization detection and gate
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__ and VllmConfig._get_quantization_config
mechanisms.observable: the checkpoint quant_method, refined by override methods probed in order, is checked against supported methods, and the method config refuses a GPU below its minimum capability
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines.

mechanisms.name: Pooler config resolution
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig.__post_init__ for the pooling runner
mechanisms.observable: user values, then sentence-transformers values, then architecture defaults fill the pooler config, and removed parameters are refused
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines.

mechanisms.name: Generation config sampling defaults
mechanisms.trigger: default sampling params requested by LLM or the serving handlers
mechanisms.observable: the model generation_config or a directory supplies defaults, with --override-generation-config on top
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title and reported lines.

mechanisms.name: Multimodal config and device resolution
mechanisms.trigger: ModelConfig and VllmConfig post-init for multimodal models
mechanisms.observable: a model with no usable modality runs text-only, the processor device folds into kwargs, auto settles after the EC role is known, and embedding inputs, video decode device and processor device are validated
mechanisms.note: mm embedding inputs, video decode device and final device validation are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Encoder-only instance resolution
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: an instance running only the multimodal encoder is recognized and prefix caching is disabled before model hooks run

mechanisms.name: Speculative config and draft resolution
mechanisms.trigger: --speculative-config or speculator checkpoint detected during EngineArgs resolution
mechanisms.observable: the method is inferred, a speculator checkpoint is rewritten into verifier plus draft, the draft ModelConfig and parallel config are built with composed overrides, and draft TP, position limits and vocab are verified
mechanisms.note: suffix, custom_class and extract_hidden_states paths, method inference and _verify_args are missing; hf-config-override has no caller.

mechanisms.name: Scheduled token budget for drafting
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__ with a speculative config
mechanisms.observable: max_num_scheduled_tokens defaults to the batched limit; a non-positive value or too few slots for drafts raises ValueError, and low values warn

mechanisms.name: Dynamic speculative decoding fallbacks
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: data parallelism drops per-batch speculative counts to the static value, and the V1 runner downgrades full cudagraphs to PIECEWISE

mechanisms.name: CUDA graph capture size planning
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__ on static-graph platforms
mechanisms.observable: unset sizes become 1, 2, 4, 8-step then 16-step up to a ceiling of 512 (1024 on the Blackwell family), plus the max batch and uniform decode sizes, with piecewise modes normalized against the compile mode
mechanisms.note: Worker-side model covers the size list and mode downgrades; max-batch and uniform-decode additions and piecewise normalization in config are missing.

mechanisms.name: Compile range planning
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__, after platform updates
mechanisms.observable: range endpoints are built from max_num_batched_tokens, allreduce and rope fusion thresholds and user values, so Inductor can compile per size range

mechanisms.name: Breakable CUDA graph auto-enable
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__
mechanisms.observable: default architectures and batch-invariant mode export VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 unless opted out, and when enabled compile mode becomes NONE

mechanisms.name: IR op priority platform defaults
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__, after compile mode is decided
mechanisms.observable: platform priorities fill unset ops and append to user lists idempotently; CUDA prefers native under Inductor, vllm_c otherwise, and oink for rms_norm when enabled

mechanisms.name: Cross-feature compatibility checks
mechanisms.trigger: VllmConfig.__post_init__ and its helper validators
mechanisms.observable: invalid combinations fail at startup: language-only with encoder cudagraphs, stochastic rounding without float16, per-request spec metrics without speculation, torch_shm without spawn, MoonEP limits, aux output and KV transfer limits
mechanisms.note: HiSparse is modeled branch for branch and watermarking and observability are covered; the checks cited here are not.

mechanisms.name: Data-parallel launch mode resolution
mechanisms.trigger: EngineArgs resolution when DP or multi-node options are set
mechanisms.observable: hybrid and external LB exclude each other, fault tolerance needs external LB, DP rank and local size settle the internal, hybrid or external mode, and the DP address and RPC port are chosen
mechanisms.note: Only the first two checks are modeled; needs-dp-coordinator matches the code and nnodes-within-dp has no caller.

mechanisms.name: Parallel topology and executor backend resolution
mechanisms.trigger: ParallelConfig construction
mechanisms.observable: world size is computed, the executor defaults to uni, mp or ray by rank count and available GPUs, invalid EPLB, fault tolerance and API rank combinations fail, and the EPLB communicator gets a default
mechanisms.note: Elastic EP setup is in its own entry; other steps read by title and reported lines.

mechanisms.name: DP group init port walk and state sync
mechanisms.trigger: engine bring-up, elastic scale and DP state exchange
mechanisms.observable: each init takes the next DP port or a stateless pick, and ranks all-reduce unfinished work, pause consensus and KV cache size across the DP group

mechanisms.name: Elastic EP and independent DP rank reconfig
mechanisms.trigger: ParallelConfig post-init with enable_elastic_ep, and rank reconfiguration
mechanisms.observable: elastic EP constraints are enforced with a maximum DP size, and a non-MoE rank can be reconfigured to run as an independent single DP instance

mechanisms.name: DCP KV interleave normalization
mechanisms.trigger: worker KV transfer init, via adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size
mechanisms.observable: cp interleave follows dcp interleave with a warning, and NIXL P/D with DCP auto-aligns it to the local block size

mechanisms.name: VllmConfig compile cache key
mechanisms.trigger: torch.compile backend and compile cache lookup
mechanisms.observable: the first 10 hex chars of a hash over vLLM version and every sub-config hash; runtime-only fields are excluded, so changing them keeps the compiled artifacts valid
mechanisms.note: Load, offload, attention, engram, LoRA, speculative and compilation factors are substituted values rather than their own compute_hash, and the model uses sha256 of JSON instead of str(factors).

mechanisms.name: Environment compile factors
mechanisms.trigger: compile cache key computation
mechanisms.observable: every known env var except an ignore list, plus Ray NOSET vars, feeds the key, so a tuning env change invalidates compiled artifacts while paths and credentials do not

mechanisms.name: Deprecated config and env migration
mechanisms.trigger: config construction with old fields or env vars
mechanisms.observable: deprecated values are copied to their replacement with a warning

mechanisms.name: CLI argument generation from config dataclasses
mechanisms.trigger: EngineArgs.add_cli_args when a parser is built
mechanisms.observable: dataclass fields and type hints become argparse options, JSON dataclass parsers and Literal choices, with human-readable numbers expanded
mechanisms.note: Only the int parser for --max-model-len style text is modeled, not field-to-option generation.

mechanisms.name: Current VllmConfig context
mechanisms.trigger: model init and code running in set_current_vllm_config
mechanisms.observable: get_current_vllm_config answers inside the context, the previous config returns on exit even on error, and a check_compile context warns when the model does not support torch.compile
mechanisms.note: Restore semantics are modeled; check_compile warnings and the compilation config cache clear are not.

mechanisms.name: Submodel config view
mechanisms.trigger: multimodal and composite model construction via with_hf_config
mechanisms.observable: a deep-copied view with the sub-config is marked is_submodel_config and skips re-validation in __post_init__
mechanisms.note: replace has no caller for this path; with_hf_config is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Concurrency properties read at runtime
mechanisms.trigger: max_concurrent_batches and in-flight readers on the engine and scheduler
mechanisms.observable: batches in flight equal the PP size plus one under async scheduling (two on V1 without PP), and in-flight token limits follow it
mechanisms.note: max_in_flight_tokens is not modeled.

mechanisms.name: Per-thread function tracing
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_TRACE_FUNCTION set when a worker thread starts
mechanisms.observable: each thread writes a call trace log under the temp dir named by instance, process and thread

mechanisms.name: Device capability probing
mechanisms.trigger: any feature check on a device capability, such as kernels, fusions or dtypes
mechanisms.observable: NVML reports the compute capability, capability and family comparisons answer feature checks, and a separate non-NVML platform class covers hosts without NVML
mechanisms.note: Non-NVML platform and get_device_total_memory are not modeled.

mechanisms.name: ROCm device and arch identification
mechanisms.trigger: import of vllm.platforms.rocm and every on_<arch> predicate
mechanisms.observable: HIP and CUDA visibility envs are synced or a conflict raises, amdsmi finds GCN arch and device count without initializing CUDA, and that sets capability and FP8 support
mechanisms.note: These answer in isolation but nothing in the model calls them (on-arch only from supports-fp8, which has no caller); env sync and GCN probing are missing.

mechanisms.name: Platform class and capability table
mechanisms.trigger: engine and worker setup asking the platform for implementations
mechanisms.observable: the platform names its communicator, Punica wrapper, static graph wrapper, pass manager and hybrid KV and static graph support, which selects those classes at runtime

mechanisms.name: NUMA topology discovery
mechanisms.trigger: worker NUMA binding and NIXL KV load core reservation
mechanisms.observable: the GPU NUMA node comes from NVML, falling back to CPU affinity on non-CDMM systems; CPU discovery reserves a core per node for KV load

mechanisms.name: XPU memory info wrapper
mechanisms.trigger: calls to torch.cuda.mem_get_info on XPU
mechanisms.observable: the device argument is normalized and bounds-checked before getMemoryInfo returns free and total
mechanisms.note: Steps read by title; only reachable from its own flow.

mechanisms.name: IO processor plugin selection
mechanisms.trigger: pooling request handling and server state init
mechanisms.observable: the plugin named at init or in the HF config loads from vllm.io_processor_plugins; none requested returns None; an uninstalled one raises
mechanisms.note: Selection matches, but no serving interface calls it.

mechanisms.name: LoRA resolver plugins
mechanisms.trigger: general plugin load, then a request naming an unloaded LoRA
mechanisms.observable: filesystem and HF Hub resolvers register by env and allowlist; on request the resolvers are tried, HF lists adapter dirs once, downloads only that directory, and a base model mismatch gives None
mechanisms.note: Registration and HF resolve are modeled, but resolve_lora has no caller and the filesystem resolver has no resolve interface.

mechanisms.name: Profiler backend selection and validation
mechanisms.trigger: worker profiler creation and VllmConfig validation
mechanisms.observable: torch, cuda or proton is chosen by config; unsupported device and activity combinations raise; Proton needs CUDA, V2 for attribution, and attribution or no CUDA graphs

mechanisms.name: Torch profiler trace output
mechanisms.trigger: the active profile session on a worker
mechanisms.observable: a torch.profiler session with wait and warmup schedule writes tensorboard traces (gzip optional) under the trace dir, with version metadata, plus time tables printed on rank 0

mechanisms.name: Frontend CPU profiler
mechanisms.trigger: AsyncLLM with frontend profiling configured
mechanisms.observable: a CPU-only torch profiler spans the whole session on the API process, ignoring engine iteration bounds
mechanisms.note: The session flag is modeled, but no frontend profiler or trace output exists.

mechanisms.name: Proton CUDA graph attribution
mechanisms.trigger: worker graph capture with proton_graph_attribution
mechanisms.observable: a Proton session stays active across cudagraph capture so replayed kernels are attributed per run, then per-phase hatchet files are written and the session is finalized at shutdown

mechanisms.name: Layerwise profile tables
mechanisms.trigger: a with-block using layerwise_profile (no caller inside the vllm package)
mechanisms.observable: Kineto events build a module tree, attributing CUDA time per layer into printable and CSV tables

mechanisms.name: Snapshot runtime identity check
mechanisms.trigger: snapshot restore before CRIU runs
mechanisms.observable: any differing runtime identity field (vLLM, Python, torch, CUDA, driver and CRIU versions, kernel, host, GPU, environment) raises SnapshotCompatibilityError naming the fields

mechanisms.name: Snapshot artifact path and marker security
mechanisms.trigger: snapshot create, restore and marker reads
mechanisms.observable: symlinks, untrusted owners, writable ancestors or a mode other than 0700 raise SnapshotSecurityError, and manifests and markers parse strictly with no symlink follow

mechanisms.name: Snapshot preflight and process inventory
mechanisms.trigger: start of create and restore, and before the CRIU dump
mechanisms.observable: Linux x86_64, CRIU, cuda-checkpoint, nvidia-smi and the plugin must exist; the tree must hold CUDA on exactly one GPU, own no io_uring, and have no external established TCP connection

mechanisms.name: Snapshot restore pin, cleanup and rollback
mechanisms.trigger: failure during or after CRIU restore
mechanisms.observable: the restored tree is pinned by pidfds, then on failure a false release marker is written, SIGTERM then SIGKILL reach the tree, shared state rolls back, and secondary failures join the error

mechanisms.name: Snapshot link remaps and external cache checks
mechanisms.trigger: CRIU dump and restore
mechanisms.observable: link-remap shm files are captured and staged back with rollback, and generated caches held by the tree are fingerprinted so a rotated cache rejects the restore early

mechanisms.name: Engine exception input dump
mechanisms.trigger: an exception during the engine step
mechanisms.observable: the config, scheduler output with tensors summarized by shape, and stats are logged at error without masking the original failure

mechanisms.name: Uvicorn access log path filter
mechanisms.trigger: server start with excluded paths set, then each access log record
mechanisms.observable: access lines for configured paths such as /health and /metrics are dropped, query string ignored, and other records pass

mechanisms.name: vllm bench serve load generation
mechanisms.trigger: vllm bench serve
mechanisms.observable: requests arrive by Poisson or gamma intervals, optionally ramped linearly or exponentially, or by self-timed traces, gated by a concurrency semaphore that records client queue time

mechanisms.name: Bench serve latency and goodput metrics
mechanisms.trigger: end of a bench serve run
mechanisms.observable: TTFT, TPOT, ITL and E2EL percentiles, throughput and SLO goodput are computed and saved, with deltas of server spec-decode and diffusion metrics

mechanisms.name: Bench serve background probe
mechanisms.trigger: bench serve with --probe-request-rate above 0
mechanisms.observable: single-token Hi probes run at the given rate during the workload and report completed, failed and latency percentiles

mechanisms.name: Bench endpoint readiness wait
mechanisms.trigger: start of a bench serve run
mechanisms.observable: a test request is retried every 5 seconds until success, or a timeout (10 minutes by default) raises

mechanisms.name: Benchmark parameter sweep
mechanisms.trigger: vllm bench sweep serve or startup
mechanisms.observable: each serve and bench combination runs the server and repeats, with warmup, failure files, resumable output and aggregated results

mechanisms.name: Startup benchmark phases
mechanisms.trigger: vllm bench startup
mechanisms.observable: cold, warmup and warm iterations start the engine in spawned subprocesses and report load and compile time statistics

mechanisms.name: Offline throughput benchmark
mechanisms.trigger: vllm bench throughput
mechanisms.observable: the vllm, async, chat or hf backend runs sampled requests and reports requests and tokens per second

mechanisms.name: Benchmark dataset sampling
mechanisms.trigger: bench serve and throughput setup, via get_samples
mechanisms.observable: the dataset name selects random, ShareGPT, trace, HF and other samplers that produce sized SampleRequests

mechanisms.name: Public asset download cache
mechanisms.trigger: ImageAsset or AudioAsset property read
mechanisms.observable: the asset downloads from the vLLM S3 bucket once into VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE, and later reads reuse the file

mechanisms.name: Video asset fetch and frame decode
mechanisms.trigger: VideoAsset property read
mechanisms.observable: the file is fetched once from an HF dataset repo into the assets cache, then frames are decoded to the requested count
mechanisms.note: Skimmed by summary only.

mechanisms.name: Build target device detection
mechanisms.trigger: setup.py on install or build
mechanisms.observable: macOS forces cpu; unsupported OSes get empty; Linux without VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE picks rocm, xpu, cuda or cpu from torch; that target drives extensions, requirements and version

mechanisms.name: Native extension CMake build
mechanisms.trigger: setup.py build_ext for the selected target
mechanisms.observable: the extension set is chosen by target and CUDA version, configured with CMake, and built with parallel jobs and compiler cache, optionally bundling tcmalloc

mechanisms.name: Precompiled wheel resolution
mechanisms.trigger: VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED build
mechanisms.observable: an explicit location wins; otherwise a variant is detected and nightly commits are searched back from merge-base, then binaries are extracted and patched into the package

mechanisms.name: Package version suffix and requirements selection
mechanisms.trigger: setup.py metadata
mechanisms.observable: the version takes a device or CUDA suffix unless overridden, and requirements come from the target file with CUDA major filtered substitutions

mechanisms.name: vllm console script dispatch
mechanisms.trigger: the vllm command
mechanisms.observable: pyproject maps vllm to the CLI main, which picks serve, bench and other subcommands, and refuses bench on an UnspecifiedPlatform
mechanisms.note: Serve and bench guard are modeled; other subcommands belong to serving-api.
